en: This stone stands for my Onix. We were together for a long, long time.
It loved Lemonade more than anything. I come here every day to keep it company.
Thank you for the Lemonade. I'm sure my Onix was glad of it.
Words are cut into the stone: 'For Onix, my dearest friend.'
Leave a can of Lemonade at the stone?
{player} set a can of Lemonade at the foot of the stone.
Oh... You left Lemonade for my Onix? That was its favourite. How kind of you.
Please, take this. I'd like you to have it.
Facade hits all the harder when a Pokémon is burned, poisoned or paralysed. My Onix never gave up, either.
A can of Lemonade sits at the foot of the stone.
